interpretation.supported: On four fixed synthetic fact-retrieval tasks, selecting one relevant source instead of 12 sources reduced actual llama.cpp reported input tokens by 84.615% while preserving all four exact answers.
not_supported: Canonical expert-robot evidence_budget model integration was not tested; tag lookup is simpler and exact source selection is predeclared.
No claim of statistically generalizable task accuracy or better reasoning; four short cases are insufficient.
Do not claim generalized wall-time acceleration: first full-context trial 58.887s, later full trials 1.391/1.833/1.516s while selected often around 3.9s.
Repeated nearly identical full contexts may exploit prompt-prefix/KV-cache reuse; cold-start and order effects are unresolved.
No demonstration of lower physical RAM, GPU/CPU cycles or trained weights, and no release qualification.
prior_failures: OCI #45080769189 left model port reachable after Studio stop, fixed with graceful close and process-group cleanup.
OCI #45081941138 confirmed cleanup but experimental direct-model requests timed out, fixed with native-style framed read1 and byte/deadline checks.
